protocol: Frozen locally before evaluation; not externally preregistered.
Source lambda_(m,chi)=strength/(m-1)^nu is specified directly, never by solving compatibility conditions.
Independent events; synchronous SIS recovery 0.15; no reinjection.
Each of eight snapshots occurs eight times per 64-step cycle for all dwell lengths. Only complete-cycle endpoints are reported.
Snapshot parameters travel with snapshots; the same fits are reused across dwell lengths.
Exact full-state endpoint references include fitted states, and are not independent generalization.
G-het fits undirected edge probabilities using binary adjacency and common labels, without source groups or multiplicities.
Expanded-set sensitivity minimizes fitted scalar count, then numeric input payload, then fixed candidate order. H is the exact fallback. This does not replace Methods complexity scores.
Feasibility uses validation and audit maximum node error; tests never enter fitting or selection.
All settings and optimizer statuses are retained, irrespective of results.
Large SIS simulations use common initial conditions and random numbers; survival is finite-horizon.
Runtime benchmarks run sequentially; numeric payload is not peak process memory.
amendment: Initial uniform 1000-iteration cap produced 34 selected G-het fits reaching the limit. All models and all settings are rerun with a common 10000-iteration/20000-evaluation cap; no source, sample, metric or network is changed. Initial results remain under results/csf_strengthening. Final protocol is an explicitly documented numerical amendment, not external preregistration.
